effective_tolerances.name: EQUILIBRIUM_WARM_PUSH
effective_tolerances.source: Ipopt 3.11.9 manual, Warm-Starting Capabilities via AMPL; #505

effective_tolerances.name: EQUILIBRIUM_WARM_MU
effective_tolerances.source: Ipopt 3.11.9 manual, monotone initial barrier for similar active sets; #505

effective_tolerances.name: CLOSE_PACKING_FRACTION
effective_tolerances.source: equal-sphere face-centred-cubic admission bound; eta >= value is a domain failure

effective_tolerances.name: SITE_FRACTION_FLOOR
effective_tolerances.source: X_a is the unbonded fraction of site a, so 0 < X_a <= 1

effective_tolerances.name: SITE_FRACTION_CEILING
effective_tolerances.source: X_a is the unbonded fraction of site a, so 0 < X_a <= 1

effective_tolerances.name: ASSOCIATION_RESIDUAL
effective_tolerances.source: Newton reaches it in 3-8 steps from a warm start

effective_tolerances.name: ASSOCIATION_ACTION_RESIDUAL
effective_tolerances.source: approved P4 normalized mass-action coefficient residual; exceeding it makes the action unavailable

effective_tolerances.name: ASSOCIATION_MAX_ITERATIONS
effective_tolerances.source: budget; measured 3-8 Newton steps

effective_tolerances.name: ASSOCIATION_BOUNDARY_FRACTION
effective_tolerances.source: fraction-to-boundary: a damped Newton step keeps X_a >= 0.1 X_a

effective_tolerances.name: ASSOCIATION_JACOBIAN_CONDITION
effective_tolerances.source: relative pivot floor in the dense solve

effective_tolerances.name: ASSOCIATION_JACOBIAN_RANK
effective_tolerances.source: FullPivLU relative rank base; multiply by the site count

effective_tolerances.name: DENSITY_ROOT_RESIDUAL
effective_tolerances.source: bracketed Newton on the reduced pressure residual; the tolerance is on the reduced residual; publish the bracket endpoint with smaller |P_calc-P_target|; relative pressure error is |r|/Z_target, with Z_target=P_target/(rho R T)

effective_tolerances.name: DENSITY_MAX_ITERATIONS
effective_tolerances.source: budget for each root refinement, spinodal bisection and slope-minimum search

effective_tolerances.name: DENSITY_BRACKET_INTERVALS
effective_tolerances.source: coarse log-density scan; slope zeros separate stable brackets before safeguarded Newton

effective_tolerances.name: DENSITY_LOWER_FRACTION
effective_tolerances.source: fraction of the ideal-gas density P/RT where the log scan starts; a root lies above it unless Z > 1e8

effective_tolerances.name: DENSITY_UPPER_FRACTION
effective_tolerances.source: fraction of the model's close-packing molar density where the log scan stops

effective_tolerances.name: DENSITY_BISECTION_FRACTION
effective_tolerances.source: bracket midpoint of the safeguarded Newton and the fold bisection

effective_tolerances.name: DENSITY_ANCHOR_LOG_WINDOW
effective_tolerances.source: approved P2 local density envelope log1p(0.01)

effective_tolerances.name: DENSITY_ANCHOR_SCAN_INTERVALS
effective_tolerances.source: approved P2 centered local anchor uniqueness scan

effective_tolerances.name: DENSITY_ANCHOR_REGULARITY
effective_tolerances.source: admitted relative density error of an anchored root, one hundredth of DENSITY_ANCHOR_LOG_WINDOW

effective_tolerances.name: DENSITY_SLOPE_SEPARATION
effective_tolerances.source: relative density separation above which two samples' P_rho order is inspected; not a rounding bound

effective_tolerances.name: DENSITY_STRUCTURE_ROUNDOFF
effective_tolerances.source: ALG-DENSITY local derivative assembly and comparison gamma_16

effective_tolerances.name: COMPOSITION_SUM_TOLERANCE
effective_tolerances.source: absolute defect of a unit sum or charge balance of O(1) terms, about 4500 ulp at 1

effective_tolerances.name: REFERENCE_MOLALITY_ONE
effective_tolerances.source: trace molality of the infinite-dilution ladder, mol/kg

effective_tolerances.name: OSMOTIC_MOLALITY_FLOOR
effective_tolerances.source: owner decision #214: common-pressure scalar cancellation reporting floor, mol/kg

effective_tolerances.name: REFERENCE_MOLALITY_TWO
effective_tolerances.source: trace molality of the infinite-dilution ladder, mol/kg

effective_tolerances.name: REFERENCE_MOLALITY_THREE
effective_tolerances.source: trace molality of the infinite-dilution ladder, mol/kg

effective_tolerances.name: REFERENCE_MOLALITY_FOUR
effective_tolerances.source: trace molality of the infinite-dilution ladder, mol/kg

effective_tolerances.name: REFERENCE_CONVERGENCE_WITNESS
effective_tolerances.source: finest trace molality of the infinite-dilution ladder, mol/kg

effective_tolerances.name: REFERENCE_CONVERGENCE_TOLERANCE
effective_tolerances.source: admitted change of the terminal-pair limit of ln(phi) and its scaled columns

effective_tolerances.name: REFERENCE_HEAT_CAPACITY_TOLERANCE
effective_tolerances.source: terminal R T^2 d2C/dT2 change, J/(mol K); ~1e-4 of solution cp, ~40x below calorimetric uncertainty

effective_tolerances.name: EQUILIBRIUM_COMPOSITION_BOX
effective_tolerances.source: Pereira 2012 inner-problem composition bound; a regularising barrier, not a solution domain or accuracy bound

effective_tolerances.name: EQUILIBRIUM_BOX_INVENTORY_FRACTION
effective_tolerances.source: largest fraction of a species' attainable inventory held by the composition box; not an accuracy bound

effective_tolerances.name: EQUILIBRIUM_BOX_FLOOR
effective_tolerances.source: dimensionless lower bound of the all-free optimizer log-composition box; not a solution domain or accuracy bound

effective_tolerances.name: PHASE_DISAPPEARANCE_AMOUNT
effective_tolerances.source: dimensionless n_phase/feed_total; provisional free-phase disappearance topology cutoff and interior guard of the split seed; not a stability result or accuracy bound

effective_tolerances.name: EQUILIBRIUM_AMOUNT_STEP_RETENTION
effective_tolerances.source: dimensionless kappa_N: an optimizer trial point keeps at least kappa_N of each free phase amount's distance to its relaxed lower bound at the search base (ALG-EQUILIBRIUM); provisional numerical choice, not an amount floor, stability result or accuracy bound

effective_tolerances.name: FIT_FUNCTION_TOLERANCE
effective_tolerances.source: relative cost decrease below which the trust-region iteration stops

effective_tolerances.name: FIT_GRADIENT_TOLERANCE
effective_tolerances.source: infinity norm of the projected optimizer-coordinate gradient at which the fit stops

effective_tolerances.name: FIT_PARAMETER_TOLERANCE
effective_tolerances.source: relative optimizer-coordinate step below which the fit stops

effective_tolerances.name: FIT_ACTIVE_BOUND_DISTANCE
effective_tolerances.source: optimizer-coordinate distance to a bound below which the coordinate is on the bound

effective_tolerances.name: LOG_RATIO_NEAR_UNITY
effective_tolerances.source: relative half-band around unity inside which ln(y / y_obs) is evaluated by log1p

effective_tolerances.name: FIT_RANK_RECIPROCAL_CONDITION
effective_tolerances.source: reciprocal condition number separating an identifiable direction from a null direction

effective_tolerances.name: FIT_DENSITY_PARAMETER_FRACTION
effective_tolerances.source: abs(new-old)/max(1,abs(new),abs(old)); includes held diameters

effective_tolerances.name: ADDITION_MATERIAL_BALANCE
effective_tolerances.source: #210: component feed balance divided by max(1 mol, endpoint feed amounts); admission of two declared endpoints and of stability inventory conservation, independent of equilibrium stopping error

effective_tolerances.name: EQUILIBRIUM_ROW_RESIDUAL
effective_tolerances.source: dimensionless equilibrium-row infinity norm; two decades above the association residual entering the assembly floor

effective_tolerances.name: EQUILIBRIUM_ACTION_BACKWARD_ERROR
effective_tolerances.source: normwise backward error of each implicit Taylor solve; catches a stale Jacobian or jet mismatch

effective_tolerances.name: EQUILIBRIUM_ACTION_FORWARD_ERROR
effective_tolerances.source: first-order relative forward-error bound 2 cond_inf(J) eta of each Taylor coefficient; owner decision 2026-09-23 (#87)

effective_tolerances.name: EQUILIBRIUM_INNER_TOLERANCE_FACTOR
effective_tolerances.source: provisional decade below the caller row criterion for the Ipopt tol, acceptable_tol, constr_viol_tol and the objective-normalized dual stop; the caller criterion classifies rows

effective_tolerances.name: EQUILIBRIUM_POLISH_STEPS
effective_tolerances.source: raw-contracting Newton steps at positive compositions, more while raw rows exceed the caller criterion; return the lowest classified residual among the optimizer start and accepted steps

effective_tolerances.name: EQUILIBRIUM_POLISH_CORRECTION
effective_tolerances.source: #272 scaled undamped Newton correction and forward-error estimate; local termination, not a state-error certificate

effective_tolerances.name: EQUILIBRIUM_TRACE_MOIETY_FRACTION
effective_tolerances.source: largest moiety size, per mol of feed, whose balance row is judged relative to that size; not an accuracy bound

effective_tolerances.name: EQUILIBRIUM_START_SPECIATION_STEP
effective_tolerances.source: largest log-amount Newton step at which the ideal start speciation stops; a start, not an accuracy bound

effective_tolerances.name: EQUILIBRIUM_START_PRESSURE_STEP
effective_tolerances.source: boundary start step; not an accuracy bound

effective_tolerances.name: EQUILIBRIUM_START_PRESSURE_PASSES
effective_tolerances.source: boundary start passes; not an accuracy bound

effective_tolerances.name: EQUILIBRIUM_MAX_ITERATIONS
effective_tolerances.source: budget; analytic equilibrium Jacobian with Ipopt

effective_tolerances.name: TANGENT_PLANE_SUBSTITUTIONS
effective_tolerances.source: count; Michelsen 1982 eq. 19 steps before eqs. 25-27, as in FeOs stability_analysis

effective_tolerances.name: EQUILIBRIUM_CALORIC_SEED_ITERATIONS
effective_tolerances.source: budget of the discardable PH/PS fixed-T seed; converged seeds took 4-14 (#579)

effective_tolerances.name: COOLING_RATIO
effective_tolerances.source: T_(j+1)/T_j of #565 recovery sources and #610 PH/PS starts

effective_tolerances.name: EQUILIBRIUM_RECOVERY_SOURCES
effective_tolerances.source: #565 lead-approved finite source schedule, ten retries per continuation step

effective_tolerances.name: EQUILIBRIUM_RECOVERY_WORK
effective_tolerances.source: #565 lead-approved added iterations and continuation attempts; 4x evaluations, 2x Hessian callbacks

effective_tolerances.name: PHASE_COINCIDENCE_DISTANCE
effective_tolerances.source: phase amount columns become numerically dependent below this composition or log-packing distance

effective_tolerances.name: PACKING_FRACTION_CEILING
effective_tolerances.source: fluid-coordinate ceiling below close packing

effective_tolerances.name: PACKING_FRACTION_FLOOR
effective_tolerances.source: fluid-coordinate floor of the log-packing chart

effective_tolerances.name: SCREENING_SERIES_SWITCH
effective_tolerances.source: crossover of closed-form cancellation and the 24-term series truncation in chi and its derivatives

effective_tolerances.name: FLOOR_MARGIN
effective_tolerances.source: provisional guessed decade of slack across first-order bound norm inequalities; predicate: residual <= FLOOR_MARGIN * floor; failure meaning: classified converged_to_floor; numerical adequacy/calibration remains open, not an accuracy bound

effective_tolerances.name: STALL_WINDOW
effective_tolerances.source: provisional guessed window below Ipopt acceptable_iter default 15; predicate: residual history has STALL_WINDOW entries without contraction; failure meaning: classified stalled; numerical adequacy/calibration remains open, not an accuracy bound
